title: StockSmart Pricing Desk Note — Fill Price from the Item's Latest Price Line During a Credit Hold
content:
**Applies to:** the first customer-owned fill of a StockSmart Vendor-Managed Inventory Program bin converted from consignment, booked while the customer's Commercial Credit Account is on hold, which is sized at a fill price read from the item's latest price line in the customer's Contract Pricing Agreement.

**Rule.** Where the item's latest price line is the addition of a Corbett-approved substitute for a discontinued item and fewer days have passed since its effective date than the agreement's discontinued item price protection days, the fill price is the line's prior unit price, the discontinued item's contract price; where the latest line is any other line that is not a removal, the fill price is its contract unit price. An item whose latest line is a removal is not re-priced under this note.

**Terms.** The latest price line is the item's line in the agreement with the latest effective date; its kind is its event, an addition, a repricing or a removal. Days passed are calendar days from the line's effective date to today. The protection days are those of the customer's Contract Pricing Agreement.

| Latest price line | Days since its effective date | Fill price |
|---|---|---|
| addition of a Corbett-approved substitute for a discontinued item | fewer than the agreement's protection days | the line's prior unit price (the discontinued item's contract price) |
| addition of a Corbett-approved substitute for a discontinued item | equal to or more than the protection days | the line's contract unit price |
| any other addition, or a repricing | any | the line's contract unit price |
| removal | any | not re-priced under this note |

**Hypothetical boundary, agreement with 90 protection days.** A substitute line effective 89 days ago gives the prior unit price; effective exactly 90 days ago it gives its own contract unit price. On an agreement with 0 protection days no number of days is fewer, so the substitute line gives its contract unit price.
